tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bde gshegs yongs 'dus las: ma chags sgrub pa'i rgyun gyi lam khyer rdo rje mi 'gyur ba bzhugs so:
che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ྈྈྈྈ

ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i ngan dgu'i dus: gdul dka'i gnyen po sgrub chen bka' brgyad las: 'jigs tshogs las kyis mnar ba'i gnyen por ni: gang 'dul zab khyad gnad du 'di bsnun no: sa ma ya: 'du 'dzi phyi shol dbang btsan nam: mdun stabs blo dang spros pas ma thengs sogs: 'dul mdzad snying po'i yang snying thig le'i dwangs: zhun mar sbyar ba'i snying po 'di rol cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas srung 'khor ni:

e: nam mkha' chos 'byung dbyer med hūm̐ mdzad mthing: hūm̐: phyi rim khro bcu mi g.yo 'khor lo 'khor: rdo rje mtshon cha ye shes me ri'i gur: de dbus mtshan rdzogs gzhal yas khang gi dbus: padma nyi zla lha klu'i gdan steng du: che mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing: rdo rje thod 'dzin dur khrod dpal chas brgyan: dbyings phyug dgyes par mnyam rol mngon par 'bar: oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha kro dhī shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karmā raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐:
de nas sgrub pa dngos la 'jug pa ni:

hūm̐ hūm̐: rang nyid rig rtsal skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen che mchog dbu ni nyi shu gcig: phyag mtshan zhe gnyis zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin: sa lam yongs rdzogs gang 'dul mdzad pa'i sku'i: zhabs brgyad lha klu byol song khri la 'gyings: spyi gtsug kun bzang bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rdzogs: spyi bor 'jam dpal mgrin par dbang chen dpal: thugs kar khrag 'thung gsang bar he ru ka: lte bar phur pa phrin las dkyil 'khor rdzogs: g.yas g.yon pus mor dregs pa drag sngags dang: rdo rje'i gshog rtser rigs lnga'i khyung chen sogs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas skur bsgoms la: dgongs pa gsal gdab bying rgod spangs byas te: snying po yang gsang rig pa'i rtsal sbyang bzlas:
zhi ba'i dal dbyangs drag po'i 'gying 'dor gyis:

zhag bdun 'bum phrag gsum bsnyen rtsa bsnyen rdzogs: rig rtsal bsre 'pho'i 'phro 'du cir yang sgyur: kha dog lnga ldan rigs kyi thugs rgyud bskul: bzlas dang rlung gi 'phro 'du'i rtsal 'byin gyis: nyi khri chig stong zhag gi grangs bsnyen 'di: gsang sngags lam gyi mthar thug 'di kho na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs thig 'di la rdzogs: phyogs bcu'i dus gsum yi dam thugs snying 'di: bzlas pas 'gro 'ong rig mdangs slar bzlums te: gsang sngags mthar thug 'jug pa gcig pu'i lam: sa ma ya: rdzogs rim ni:

1$0000250lha dang sngags la rtsol byed rang snang de: gsal bzhin gsal ba'i ngo bo rang gsal gdab: gsal cha gnyis med ngo bo rang grol gyi: don gyi lam 'di bzhag pa'i yul mgo mthong: cir snang ngo bo chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan: snang ba lhar shar stong pa rang grol gyis: bde klong gnyis med rang grol rol pa cher: ched 'dzin 'dus ma ye byas gnas 'di 'grub: snang ba che mchog stong pa gnam zhal gyi: ngo bo de las logs su rtsol sgrub stong: yi dam rang ngo shar zhing re dogs stong: rtsol med yengs pa med pa'i lam khyer 'dis: grub pa'i rang sa zin gyi gzhan las min: rang gsal lta ba mi g.yo bsgom pa'i ngang: rtsol med spyod pa yengs med 'bras bu yi: mi g.yo gdod ma'i gzhi yi sa zungs shig: 1$0000300

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal mgon dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bka' 'di srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes rol pa bde chen khang nas spyan drangs pa'i rin po che'i shog ser las/ klong gsal snying pos khol ri gsang sngags sgrub khang rtser dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni kun bzang padma stobs chen no// maṅga laṃ/// /
